_comment: The standard production-readiness checklist every web app shares (Google SRE Production Readiness Review + the four golden signals, per system). Reif 2026-09-24: 'almost all software is the same: a server, a database, analytics' -- so the blind-spot audit starts from this list instead of discovering the world from scratch. scripts/coverage_map.py scores every item daily as watched (some member's mandate.watches names it AND that member has run recently) / unwatched / n/a (the system it needs is absent from live inventory). `needs` = the inventory kind that makes an item applicable. Add an item here when a new class of failure is found by hand; never delete one to make the map green.

items.item: request latency (p50/p95) per service, against a budget
traffic volume per service, with a drop alarm
error rate / user-facing breakage per service
saturation: pool, CPU, connection headroom
slow queries: pg_stat_statements top-N by total and max time
index misses: sequential scans on big tables
connections vs max_connections, pool sizing, idle-in-transaction
statement_timeout / idle timeouts set per role
lock waits and long-running transactions
app uses a least-privilege role, not the admin role
backups/PITR exist AND a restore has been tested recently
CPU load, memory, disk per host
error rate in system/app logs
service crash/restart counts
edge 5xx rate
WAF challenges hitting real users or monitors
cache hit rate
every scheduled job's last exit code and failure count
deadman: a job that stopped running at all is noticed
data ingests fresh (last success within their cadence)
deploy success rate
one-command rollback exists and a bad deploy gets reverted
OWASP top 10 exercised against the live app
injection/unsafe-SQL lint on every change
secrets scan of the product repo and deploys
dependency CVE scan
TLS certificate expiry
DNS records drift / takeover risk
SPF / DKIM / DMARC valid
bounce and complaint rate
analytics events (GA4/PostHog) still flowing
Search Console indexation / coverage
payment webhooks delivered and processed
failed charges / disputes
infra + third-party spend vs budget
API quotas (GSC, PostHog, LLM accounts) vs limits
